story.p1: This project was born from a personal need: I wanted a simple tool to study Japanese with flashcards.
story.p2: While using another app to learn hiragana, I wanted to start practicing katakana and found out that feature was behind a paid subscription. Instead of paying for something I didn't need to be that complex, I decided to build my own.
story.p3: The app lets you practice hiragana and katakana, recognize Japanese words and phrases, and train writing them in romaji. You can also add your own content to tailor practice to whatever you want to learn.
story.p4: The idea isn't to reinvent learning Japanese, but to make a simple, useful and free tool, born from a real need.
story.p5: I originally built it for myself. If it can also help other people learning Japanese, even better.
